item.title: Base Building in 99 Nights in the Forest — Walls, Traps and Layout
item.description: A good base in 99 Nights in the Forest is a ring of defenses around a strong campfire, with storage inside and choke points outside. The standard layout Campfire core — everything is built within its light radius. Wall ring — one layer early, two layers once the Ram starts appearing. Trap lanes — traps on the paths enemies use, not spread evenly. Storage inside — shelves and crates next to the fire, so defenders restock fast.

item.title: Campfire Upgrades in 99 Nights in the Forest — What to Level First
item.description: The campfire is your light, heat and anchor. Upgrading it changes how safely your squad can play — and it gates content like the fishing chat code. Why the campfire matters Night survival — a brighter, higher-level fire keeps threats at bay and marks your safe zone. Content unlocks — level 2 grants access to the fishing rod path, which enables the yay fishing chat code (2 Gems). Base value — the fire area is where walls, traps, shelves and crates do their work; a weak fire makes a strong base pointless.

item.title: First 10 Nights in 99 Nights in the Forest — Day-by-Day Route
item.description: This is the route most new squads follow to get through the first 10 nights without wiping. Build by day, guard the fire by night. Days 1–2 · Get established Spend daylight chopping wood and gathering food to keep hunger up. Craft a basic axe and spear. At night: stay glued to the campfire. Never overextend in the dark. Days 3–4 · Scale up Once wood is stockpiled, push crafting bench upgrades first — they unlock better tools and recipes.

item.title: How to Play 99 Nights in the Forest — Beginner's Guide
item.description: 99 Nights in the Forest is a co-op survival horror game on Roblox: by day you gather, craft and build; by night, creatures attack your campfire. Your run succeeds when you survive the nights, keep the fire burning, and rescue the missing children. The core loop Every day follows the same rhythm: Gather — chop wood, pick up food and materials around the map. Craft & upgrade — the crafting bench unlocks better tools; upgrades cost wood and materials.
